text:
sarah.j: Heads-up — AcmeCorp's procurement won't approve the AWS Marketplace listing. They're asking for a vendor payee/vendor code, an explicit PO flow, and they've pushed back on our marketplace fee language. Legal also redlined sections on indemnity/termination. Can we escalate to deal desk? :thinking_face:

alex.k: Can you paste the exact redlines/legal notes? Also who is the Acme procurement contact? I can loop in AWS BD if we need partner-managed billing as a workaround.

sarah.j: Procurement contact is emily.harris@acme.com. Legal redlines are: 1) remove unilateral indemnity, 2) shorten termination notice, 3) require DPA + SOC2 proof. Here's the excerpt Legal sent:```
"Customer requires mutual indemnification for third-party claims and removal of vendor unilateral termination clause."
```

mike.c: Ok. Two pragmatic options:
- Short path: offer partner-managed billing (Acme pays Redwood directly) — this avoids marketplace vendor onboarding, vendor code, and can go live in ~7 business days after PO.
- Long path: push through marketplace listing but need AWS vendor registration + legal signoff — likely 2-4 weeks.

anna.t (legal-bot): Summarizing legal stance: we can accept a mutual indemnity limited to claims arising from our gross negligence or willful misconduct, and we can reduce termination notice to 30 days (instead of 60) with prorated refunds. DPA must be executed; we can attach our standard DPA. We cannot accept uncapped liability.

sarah.j: Good — can you draft the minimal redline language we can send Acme? Also we need the PO template they will use. @alex.k any chance you can share a vendor onboarding checklist for AWS marketplace (vendor code, tax ID, banking info)?

alex.k: AWS checklist already — sharing the minimal fields Acme needs to provide:```
Vendor name: Redwood Inference Inc
Tax ID: 12-3456789
Payee address: 123 Redwood Way, SF, CA
Banking: ACH details (sent after vendor registration)
PO#: <customer PO goes here>
```
I'll DM the full AWS vendor registration link to Sarah.

deal-desk-bot: Escalation created: MD-842. Assigned to deal-desk@redwood.com. Priority: high. :white_check_mark:

mike.c: Action items: 1) Sarah to confirm whether Acme accepts partner-managed billing; 2) Anna to prepare the DPA + redline note for mutual indemnity cap language; 3) Alex to share vendor onboarding link and timeline; 4) Deal desk to coordinate with AWS BD if marketplace listing required.

sarah.j: I've emailed Emily with the partner-managed billing option and attached our PO template. If she wants marketplace flow, I'll book a sync with Acme + AWS BD for tomorrow.

anna.t: I'll draft the attached redline and send to Sarah by EOD. If Acme pushes for uncapped liability we should escalate to VP Legal.

alex.k: Timeline note: if they provide vendor details today and accept our redlines, AWS vendor verification + listing typically completes in 5-7 business days. If they insist on marketplace invoicing with custom legal terms, add 2 weeks.

sarah.j: Thanks all — will update thread after Emily responds. :eyes:
